**Incarnate Resilience (Ex):** At 5th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immune to disease.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 5th level.

**Pyre Resilience (Ex):** At 9th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immune to poison.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 9th level.

**Mental Resilience (Ex):** At 11th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immune to exhaustion and mind-affecting effects that would prevent her from acting. She can draw such effects out of allies when she reclaims essence from them.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 9th level.

**Temporal Resilience (Ex):** At 13th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immune to magical aging and any effect that would make time pass faster or slower for her. She can draw such effects out of allies when she reclaims essence from them.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 13th level.

**Primordial Resilience (Ex):** At 15th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immune to the confused condition. She can draw the confused condition out of allies when she reclaims essence from them.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 15th level.

**Deathless Unity (Ex):** At 17th level, the Unity ascendant becomes immortal and immune to death effects. She takes no penalty from negative levels (although they still kill her when they exceed her hit dice). She can draw negative levels out of allies when she reclaims essence from them.

This ability replaces the martyr's renewal improvements gained at 17th level.
